description: This file defines AI difficulty levels, player control types, and classes related to configuring players and AI in a local Ludo match, including serialization/deserialization methods.

classes.name: PlayerControllerAssignment
classes.description: Represents the assignment of a player control to a specific color, including whether it's human or AI, and the AI difficulty if applicable.

classes.name: LocalMatchConfig
classes.description: Snapshot configuration for a local game setup, specifying control assignments for each color.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the object to a JSON-compatible map.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes an object from a JSON-compatible map.

methods.name: assignmentFor
methods.description: Returns the PlayerControllerAssignment for a specific LudoColor.

methods.name: allHuman
methods.description: Factory constructor returning a match config with all players human.

methods.name: humansVsAi
methods.description: Factory constructor configuring a mix of human and AI players with specified counts and difficulty.
